lines: d21: 📖 The Codex turns a page on its own. Dorothy Desai is dead. You didn't ask. It knew.
d21: Nobody's talking much. The fire feels smaller tonight.
d21: 🕯️ Dorothy Desai is dead — sickness. The village stops. Somebody screams. Somebody else starts digging.
d21: What Dorothy kept close goes into the ground with them — keepsakes are buried, never taken from the body.
d21: "Dorothy's gone." Maya looks at you for a long moment. "You're not Dorothy." No heat in it. Just fact. You'll have to earn this face.
d21: The Codex doesn't pause for grief. DeAndre blinks — and it's already there, overlaying everything, syncing. No pen. No paper. The mantle just... transfers.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Field Dressing (Level 1). Break down game fast and clean. Less waste, more meat, usable parts.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Steady Hands (Level 1). Fine work under pressure. Dressing game, stitching wounds, tying snares — no shake.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Anatomy (Level 1). You know where the important bits are. Arteries, joints, organs. Useful for healing or hurting.
d21: 📖 LEARNED: Wound Care (Level 1). Clean it, close it, cover it. Pressure stops bleeding. Clean water is better than dirty hands.
d21: ⚡ TECHNIQUE UNLOCKED: Precise Mend! Your healing knows where to go. +50% effectiveness. (Your knowledge of Wound Care amplifies your field_medicine.)
d21: 🌟 "MANTLE TRANSFER DETECTED. ...Oh! New face! Same job! Whole new set of tricks. We hardly noticed. (That is a lie. We noticed. The audience CRIED.)"
d21: 📖 The Codex turns a page: Dorothy Desai, 21 days. The mantle passes to DeAndre Guerrero.
d21: 🪞 You wake up somebody else. DeAndre Guerrero, 20 — a Butcher. Their hands know different work now: Green Whisper, Green Thumb, Literally.
d21: The village's quarrel was with Dorothy — and Dorothy is dead. The sentence doesn't cross the grave. You're someone else now; the docket is empty, but the village remembers.
d21: At the grave, Addison, Maya speak for DeAndre — "Dorothy trusted them. We saw it. Give them the fire's hearing." The village listens.
d21: The fire knew DeAndre before the Codex did — their name already carried weight here.
